# Ace Data Cloud

> Unified AI API platform — One API key for 100+ AI services including LLM chat, image generation, video generation, music creation, web search, and more.

Ace Data Cloud provides developer-friendly REST APIs for AI services. All APIs use Bearer token authentication, return JSON responses, and have OpenAPI specifications. The platform also offers MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for seamless AI agent integration.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/introduction): Platform overview and core advantages
- [Quick Start](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/quickstart): Get started in 5 minutes
- [Authentication](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/authentication): How to authenticate API requests
- [API Reference](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/authentication): Full OpenAPI specs for all endpoints

## AI Chat APIs

- [Claude API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/claude/claude_chat_completions): Anthropic Claude chat completions via OpenAI-compatible interface
- [OpenAI API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/openai/openai_chat_completions): GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, o3, o4-mini and more via OpenAI-compatible interface
- [Gemini API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/gemini/gemini_chat_completions): Google Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro via OpenAI-compatible interface
- [DeepSeek API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/deepseek/deepseek_chat_completions): DeepSeek R1, V3 via OpenAI-compatible interface
- [Grok API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/grok/grok_chat_completions): xAI Grok via OpenAI-compatible interface
- [Kimi API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/kimi/kimi_chat_completions): Moonshot Kimi via OpenAI-compatible interface

## AI Image APIs

- [Midjourney API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/midjourney/midjourney_imagine): Generate images with Midjourney
- [Flux API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/flux/flux_images): Generate images with Flux (6 models)
- [Seedream API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/seedream/seedream_images): ByteDance Seedream image generation and editing
- [Nano Banana API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/nano-banana/nanobanana_images): Gemini-based image generation with virtual try-on
- [QR Art API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/qrart/qrart_generate): AI-powered artistic QR code generation
- [Face API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/face-change/face_swap): Face swap, beautify, cartoon, age change, and more
- [Headshots API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/drawai/headshots_generation): AI professional headshot generation

## AI Video APIs

- [Sora API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/sora/sora_videos): OpenAI Sora text-to-video and image-to-video
- [Veo API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/veo/veo_videos): Google Veo video generation
- [Luma API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/luma/luma_videos): Luma Dream Machine video generation
- [Kling API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/kling/kling_videos): Kuaishou Kling video generation
- [Hailuo API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/hailuo/hailuo_videos): MiniMax Hailuo video generation
- [Seedance API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/seedance/seedance_videos): ByteDance Seedance video generation
- [Wan API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/wan/wan_videos): Tongyi Wanxiang video generation

## AI Audio APIs

- [Suno API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/suno/suno_audios): AI music generation — create songs, extend, cover, remix
- [Fish API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/fish/fish_audios): Text-to-speech with voice cloning
- [Producer API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/producer/producer_audios): AI music production with stem separation

## Web & Data APIs

- [SERP API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/serp/serp_google): Google search results (web, images, news, shopping, maps)
- [Short URL API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/shorturl/short_url): URL shortening with batch support
- [Localization API](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/guides/localization/localization_translation): JSON translation service

## MCP Servers

Model Context Protocol servers for AI agent integration with Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and other MCP-compatible clients. Install via pip.

- [SunoMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/suno): AI music generation
- [MidjourneyMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/midjourney): AI image generation
- [SerpMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/serp): Google search
- [LumaMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/luma): AI video generation (Luma)
- [SoraMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/sora): AI video generation (Sora)
- [VeoMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/veo): AI video generation (Veo)
- [FluxMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/flux): AI image generation (Flux)
- [SeedreamMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/seedream): AI image generation (Seedream)
- [SeedanceMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/seedance): AI video generation (Seedance)
- [NanoBananaMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/nanobanana): AI image generation (Gemini)
- [ShortURLMCP](https://docs.acedata.cloud/en/mcp/shorturl): URL shortening

## Pricing

Pay-as-you-go with no monthly fees. Each API call costs credits based on the model and parameters used. Free tier available for testing. Supports payment via Stripe, Alipay, WeChat Pay, and X402 crypto protocol (USDC).
